title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-util-reporting-v10: tighten burst budgets and add per-fleet utilization_metrics
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Fleet autoscaling needs safer burst behaviour and better visibility to avoid tail latency spikes for Dedicated customers. This PR tightens burst budgets, adds per-fleet utilization metrics and surface-level reporting in the console, and improves the autoscaler decision logic to prefer graceful capacity fallbacks. Changes are designed to be non-breaking and opt-in via config flags. Summary of changes: 1) Introduced burst_budget_ms and burst_tokens cap per fleet with sensible defaults and rate-window alignment. 2) Autoscaler: added a soft-threshold mode that prevents immediate scale-down if burst_budget has been consumed recently. 3) Telemetry: added per-fleet metrics (fleet_utilization_percent, fleet_burst_consumed_ms, fleet_burst_tokens_used, autoscaler_decision_reason) and an aggregation endpoint used by the console. 4) Console: small reporting panel that shows current utilization and recent burst events. 5) Tests: unit tests for budget accounting, integration test that simulates bursty QPS, and a perf benchmark to ensure no regression in decision latency. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag fleet.autoscaler.v10; default enabled for internal dedicated fleets only, then opt-in customers, then global. Monitor dashboards during rollout for autoscaler decision churn and tail latency. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked ENG-4821 - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Metrics and dashboards wired - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Load-tested in perf-lab (limited) Known limitations: This PR does not change underlying pod allocation logic for heterogeneous fleets (follow-up PR planned). Also does not change pricing or SLA guarantees. Requesting review from runtime and infra for potential regressions and from observability for metric naming and cardinality recommendations.
commits: Add burst budget fields and defaults
Telemetry: emit per-fleet utilization metrics and aggregation endpoint
review_comments: Aisha Patel: We should ensure metric cardinality stays bounded; consider removing fleet name tag for high-card fleets.
Sofia Martinez: Good point, switched fleet.name to fleet.id and added cardinality note in metrics.rs (see commit 2/3).
Marco Chen: Suggest we add an emergency fallback that immediately disables burst allowance if memory pressure is detected on nodes.
Sofia Martinez: Added memory-pressure check to soft-threshold logic and unit tests (commit 3/3).
Evan Thompson: CI perf test failed on first run due to benchmark network flakiness; re-run looks good. Approving once perf pass is green.
release_notes: Improved dedicated autoscaler safety and visibility: added burst budget caps, soft-threshold scale-down avoidance, and per-fleet utilization metrics. Opt-in via fleet.autoscaler.v10. See docs/release-notes/dedicated-autoscaler-v10.md for details.
notes: This PR was load-tested against perf-canary with synthetic burst patterns. We observed a 22% reduction in scale-down churn and eliminated occasional tail-latency spikes (>95th percentile) in staging. Metrics names chosen to match existing conventions; observability accepted cardinality constraints.
